metadata.title: Dosa Coffee Kitchen Tour & New Menu Tasting in Delhi I Benne Dosa + Guntur Karam Dosa + FilterCoffee
metadata.description:
In today’s episode, we take you inside the central kitchen of Dosa Coffee in Delhi, where batters and spice powders for all 11 outlets are prepared in a fully mechanised, hygienic, and standardised setup. From large-scale machines to well-organised dry storage, this facility ensures consistency and quality across every location in the city.

The episode then moves to the Connaught Place outlet in the heart of Delhi for a tasting of some of their new menu options. We try the thatte idli, soft and airy, the open butter masala dosa with its crisp edges and generous topping, and the benne dosa, rich with butter. The cheese paniyaaram adds a playful twist, while banana masala chips bring crunch and spice. The fiery Guntur karam dosa stands out for its bold flavours, followed by comforting kheer and Dosa Coffee’s signature filter coffee to round things off.

A mix of behind-the-scenes access and on-table tasting, this episode celebrates the scale, precision, and flavours that make Dosa Coffee a favourite in Delhi.
